liveForm.event: Danyang governor while favored by Wang Dao after the great rebels were newly pacified.

exactChinese.s0400: 丹陽尹桓景佞事王導，甚為導所昵。
exactChinese.s0390: 時大賊新平，綱維弛廢，司徒王導以回有器幹，擢補北軍中候，俄轉中護軍。
exactChinese.s0389: 尋王師敗績，回還本縣，收合義軍，得千餘人，並為步軍，與陶侃、溫嶠等並力攻峻，又別破韓晁，以功封康樂伯。
exactChinese.note: s0389 is the prior campaign unit (並力攻峻 / 破韓晁); s0390 時大賊新平 is the adjacent “newly pacified” frame cited with claim-1050; neither unit supplies a year numeral for 桓景.

minimumConservativeFinding.problem: claim-1050 still asserts westernBounds onOrAfter AD 328 / onOrBefore AD 339 for「丹陽尹桓景佞事王導」, but s0400 and cited s0390 (時大賊新平) contain no reign-year or convertible numeral. The bounds are external narrative inference, not source-warranted precision.
minimumConservativeFinding.action: Accept the owner’s separately submitted undatedSourceAttestation proposal when applied; until then keep claim-1050 as a residual incorrect-bounds row. Do not invent a point year; do not treat 328–339 as approved; do not widen into other SuJun continuum holds.
